visual_events.description: From 0.0s to approximately 4.5s, the camera tilts smoothly downward from the upper courses of a curved, light-grey/greenish-grey exposed masonry wall with overhanging green leaves in the upper right foreground and reddish-brown horizontal decorative bands, revealing a recessed arched window with a reddish-brown brick arch, white horizontal metal security bars, and closed brown wooden shutters. From approximately 4.5s to 9.13s, the camera settles into a steady hold framing the full arched window and its sill, on which a small round green fruit (resembling a lime or small apple) sits near the center-left and a small dark cluster of objects rests on the right, while dappled sunlight and leaf shadows shift slightly across the wall.
